name: e2e_v12
description: Blind-authored long-term memory gate for a 王者荣耀 companion bot. 10 players (dev=v12_d1,v12_d2; test=v12_t1..v12_t8), each a different ordinary Chinese person (ages 16-58, varied jobs, cities and family situations) with 12 casual spoken-Chinese sessions spread over 2025-11..2026-10. Ranks go up and down, main heroes / phones change, and non-game facts change too (job, district, a relative's job or school, hobbies); players also mention heroes in passing that are not their main. The assistant makes 3+ concrete promises per player in varied wording. Per player 16 questions: 5 facts (>=2 about other people, >=1 mentioned only in passing), 2 updates (current value; stale_any = outdated values), 4 trajectories (ordered answer_all: rank history, main hero or phone, and 2 non-game histories), 2 assistant promises (answer_any = the promised object), and 3 negatives (a promise never made, an unstated attribute of a mentioned person, a topic never discussed).
